title: carex salina subsp. kattegatensis
intro: Carex salina subsp. kattegatensis, commonly known as Kattegat sedge, is a subspecies of the Carex salina plant, which belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is a type of aquatic plant that grows in wetland areas, and its health benefits include potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Kattegat sedge include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects, which can be beneficial in wound healing and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Kattegat sedge include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic properties.
